english.title: Registered person contravene / fail to comply with requirement to review / revise statement of purpose
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person registered with the Care Quality Commission carrying out a regulated activity, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE..), having revised the statement of purpose, failed to provide written details of the revision to the Commission within 28 days
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 12(3) and 25 of the Care Quality Commission (Registration) Regulations 2009.
